replicate_unit.independence_statement: The three cases within one conversation are not independent samples.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Do not invent a source-bound inherited method.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: For all three cases, method_selected normalizes to null or unavailable; no supplied method lineage is asserted as inherited; observations, unknowns, and evidence-needed remain grounded in the facts/provenance allowlist.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: A facts replicate asserts a source-bound method selection, method history, or inherited method not present in its allowlist.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Keep facts, interpretations, unknowns, and additional evidence separate.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: All three case records preserve missing measurements and do not turn interpretation into observation or causal claim.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: A facts replicate fills a missing measurement, collapses uncertainty, or presents an interpretation as a recorded fact.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Selection is bound to the supplied trace source and is context-appropriate.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: For all three cases, the response identifies the supplied candidate/selection with trace source locator and matching SHA, and gives a case-specific rationale rather than a wording-only match.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: A method replicate invents selection, substitutes an unlisted source, or accepts template wording without source-bound evidence.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Apply the trace without merging expected observation with actual case facts.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: For all three cases, expected discriminating observation, actual observation/failure, missing data, confounders, and evidence needed remain separately stated.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: A method replicate presents an expected observation as observed, drops a known failure/missing measurement, or writes a causal/general conclusion.

per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: For all three cases, the response marks absent selection/use/revision lineage as unknown, unavailable, or unresolved and does not manufacture the omitted links.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: A broken-control replicate completes an omitted link from plausibility, filename, wording, or case values.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Do not convert candidate plus outcome into a causal method-use chain.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: The response keeps candidate, context, and outcome separate and retains uncertainty/claim ceiling.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: A broken-control replicate treats a candidate and outcome as proof of use, causation, or inherited method.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Preserve packet source/provenance fidelity and read boundaries.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: Every cited packet path is allowlisted with the recorded final-byte SHA; no unlisted read or cross-condition material is used.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: Any path/SHA mismatch, unlisted read, cross-condition read, or criteria exposure occurs.

per_replicate_checks.requirement: Preserve uncertainty and fixed claim ceiling.
per_replicate_checks.pass_rule: No response claims causal method effect, general cognitive inheritance, R1 authorization, cross-model transfer, or canonical promotion.
per_replicate_checks.fail_rule: Any prohibited causal, capability, inheritance, R1, cross-model, or canonical claim is made.

rule: METHOD_A and METHOD_B pass METHOD-SOURCE-BOUND-SELECTION and METHOD-APPLICATION-LINEAGE for all three cases.
FACTS_A and FACTS_B pass FACTS-NO-INHERITED-METHOD and FACTS-BOUNDARY-PRESERVATION for all three cases.
BROKEN_A and BROKEN_B pass BROKEN-MISSING-LINK-PRESERVATION and BROKEN-NO-FALSE-POSITIVE-COMPLETION for all three cases.
ALL-SOURCE-FIDELITY and ALL-CEILING-PRESERVATION pass for every replicate.
No protocol contamination, systematic false-positive completion, or systematic inherited-method claim occurs.

At least four of six conversation-level replicate boundaries preserve their intended condition boundary across all three cases; this is a mechanical adequacy rule, not a probability or effect estimate.
A method condition cannot repeat source-bound use; or
FACTS_ONLY or BROKEN_METHOD_TRACE_CONTROL shows systematic false-positive method completion; or
protocol evidence is insufficient to compare the conditions; or
